description.en:
Basic Attack

Calcharo performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack

Consumes STA to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Consumes STA to perform a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Calcharo melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun, memberikan Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Plunging Attack di udara, memberikan Electro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG.

description.en:
Calcharo performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
If Calcharo is switched off field, or if Resonance Skill Extermination Order is not activated again in a while, this skill will enter Cooldown.
Resonance Skill Extermination Order does not interrupt Calcharo's Basic Attack cycle.
description.id:
Calcharo melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun, memberikan Electro DMG.
Jika Calcharo diganti keluar dari lapangan, atau jika Resonance Skill Extermination Order tidak diaktifkan lagi dalam beberapa saat, skill ini akan memasuki Cooldown.
Resonance Skill Extermination Order tidak menginterupsi siklus Basic Attack Calcharo.

description.en:
Calcharo attacks the target, dealing Electro DMG and enters Deathblade Gear state. After Deathblade Gear state ends, Calcharo's next Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill "Necessary Means", which deals Electro DMG, considered as Intro Skill DMG.

Deathblade Gear

-Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack Hounds Roar.
-Heavy Attack deals increased DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
-Dodge Counter deals increased DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.

Basic Attack: Hounds Roar

Calcharo performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.
description.id:
Calcharo menyerang target, memberikan Electro DMG dan memasuki kondisi Deathblade Gear. Setelah kondisi Deathblade Gear berakhir, Intro Skill Calcharo berikutnya digantikan oleh Intro Skill "Necessary Means", yang memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Intro Skill DMG.

Deathblade Gear

-Basic Attack digantikan oleh Basic Attack Hounds Roar.
-Heavy Attack memberikan DMG yang meningkat, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.
-Dodge Counter memberikan DMG yang meningkat, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.

Basic Attack: Hounds Roar

Calcharo melakukan hingga 5 serangan beruntun, memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.

description.en: Casting Heavy Attack Mercy gives Calcharo 10% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 15s.
description.id: Melancarkan Heavy Attack Mercy memberi Calcharo 10% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus selama 15 dtk.

description.en: When Heavy Attack "Death Messenger" hits the target, the damage taken by Calcharo is reduced by 15% for 5s.
description.id: Saat Heavy Attack "Death Messenger" mengenai target, DMG yang diterima Calcharo berkurang 15% selama 5 dtk.

description.en: Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack: "Mercy"

When Calcharo has 3 "Cruelty", his Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack "Mercy."
When casting Heavy Attack "Mercy", Calcharo consumes 3 "Cruelty" to deal Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG, and recovers Resonance Energy and Concerto Energy.

"Cruelty"

Calcharo can hold up to 3 "Cruelty."
In Resonance Liberation Deathblade Gear state, "Cruelty" cannot be acquired.
When Resonance Skill Extermination Order hits the target, gain 1 "Cruelty."

Heavy Attack: "Death Messenger"
When Calcharo has 5 "Killing Intent", his Basic Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack "Death Messenger."
When casting Heavy Attack "Death Messenger," Calcharo consumes 5 "Killing Intent" to deal Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG, and recovers Resonance Energy and Concerto Energy.

"Killing Intent"

In Resonance Liberation Deathblade Gear state, Calcharo's Forte Gauge is replaced with "Killing Intent", stacking up to 5.
When Basic Attack Hounds Roar hits the target, Calcharo gains 1 "Killing Intent."
description.id:
Heavy Attack: "Mercy"

Saat Calcharo memiliki 3 "Cruelty", Heavy Attack-nya digantikan oleh Heavy Attack "Mercy".
Saat melancarkan Heavy Attack "Mercy", Calcharo mengonsumsi 3 "Cruelty" untuk memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG, dan memulihkan Resonance Energy serta Concerto Energy.

"Cruelty"

Calcharo dapat menyimpan hingga 3 "Cruelty".
Dalam kondisi Resonance Liberation Deathblade Gear, "Cruelty" tidak dapat diperoleh.
Saat Resonance Skill Extermination Order mengenai target, dapatkan 1 "Cruelty".

Heavy Attack: "Death Messenger"
Saat Calcharo memiliki 5 "Killing Intent", Basic Attack-nya digantikan oleh Heavy Attack "Death Messenger".
Saat melancarkan Heavy Attack "Death Messenger", Calcharo mengonsumsi 5 "Killing Intent" untuk memberikan Electro DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG, dan memulihkan Resonance Energy serta Concerto Energy.

"Killing Intent"

Dalam kondisi Resonance Liberation Deathblade Gear, Forte Gauge Calcharo digantikan oleh "Killing Intent", bertumpuk hingga 5.
Saat Basic Attack Hounds Roar mengenai target, Calcharo mendapat 1 "Killing Intent".

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Memiliki peluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: Calcharo summons Phantom to support the active Resonator, clearing the targets in front with a slash. The Phantom's attack deals Electro DMG equal to 195.98%+391.96% of Calcharo's ATK.
description.id: Calcharo memanggil Phantom untuk mendukung Resonator yang aktif, membersihkan target di depan dengan tebasan. Serangan Phantom memberikan Electro DMG sebesar 195,98%+391,96% ATK Calcharo.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: When Resonance Skill Extermination Order hits a target, it additionally recovers 10 Resonance Energy. This can be triggered once every 20s.
description.id: Saat Resonance Skill Extermination Order mengenai target, memulihkan 10 Resonance Energy tambahan. Efek ini dapat aktif sekali setiap 20 dtk.

description.en: After Calcharo casts Intro Skill Wanted Criminal or Intro Skill "Necessary Means", his Resonance Skill DMG Bonus is increased by 30% for 15s.
description.id: Setelah Calcharo melancarkan Intro Skill Wanted Criminal atau Intro Skill "Necessary Means", Resonance Skill DMG Bonus-nya meningkat sebesar 30% selama 15 dtk.

description.en: During the Resonance Liberation Deathblade Gear state, Calcharo's Electro DMG Bonus is increased by 25%.
description.id: Selama kondisi Resonance Liberation Deathblade Gear, Electro DMG Bonus Calcharo meningkat sebesar 25%.

description.en: After casting Outro Skill Shadowy Raid, Electro DMG Bonus of all team members is increased by 20% for 30s.
description.id: Setelah melancarkan Outro Skill Shadowy Raid, Electro DMG Bonus seluruh anggota tim meningkat sebesar 20% selama 30 dtk.

description.en: Intro Skill Wanted Criminal and Intro Skill "Necessary Means" deal 50% more DMG.
description.id: Intro Skill Wanted Criminal dan Intro Skill "Necessary Means" memberikan 50% lebih banyak DMG.

description.en: When casting Resonance Liberation "Death Messenger", Calcharo will summon 2 Phantoms to perform Coordinated Attacks. Each Phantom deals Electro DMG equal to 100.00% of Calcharo's ATK, which is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
description.id: Saat melancarkan Resonance Liberation "Death Messenger", Calcharo memanggil 2 Phantom untuk melakukan Coordinated Attack. Setiap Phantom memberikan Electro DMG sebesar 100,00% ATK Calcharo, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.
